qualifications.syntax: Pinned qpdf on the actual PDF workload bytes. The complete consumed giant input is retained as lossless gzip, rehydrated without shortening for every producer.
qualifications.standards: Original qualified T03 22-rule blank-document union applies to every actual scale page and the actual PDF 1.7 input. No font/layout/conformance predicate is claimed.
qualifications.semantic: Public Worker reopen plus independent qpdf graph traversal of every actual blank page; no miniature substitute.
qualifications.visual: Original 144-DPI opaque-sRGB white AE-zero and zero-fuzz blank raster at first/middle/final pages of the actual 5000-page file, every concurrency output and actual one-page 1-GiB input. This is a declared sample, not full-document visual or rendering certification.
qualifications.facade: Existing public lifecycle operations execute IN_PROCESS; transaction/recovery/resource controls remain Native only.
qualifications.resources: Full finite Workflow policies and modeled Folio memory/storage observations; no JVM heap/process RSS/native memory/kernel/secure-erasure claim.
qualifications.termination-wait: Real Worker/public workflow regressions: an actual managed child alive beyond one second exits within the 30-second post-FINISHED grace; delayed parent observation rechecks liveness; actual grace expiry retains elapsed/liveness/bounded process/thread-state diagnostics before forced termination. Cancellation, caller deadline, the default five-minute elapsed bound and interruption still prevent publication with ordered NOT_ATTEMPTED receipts, RECOVERABLE lookup, unchanged Target sentinels, confirmed child termination and owned-storage cleanup. Success retains COMMITTED receipt, COMPLETED lookup and public reopen. Only the full-grace expiry case uses a 60-second JUnit timeout; other new exit cases use 10 seconds. Fixture launcher and Clock remain outside the qualified runtime closure. Every post-FINISHED failure retains the original failure code/capability/receipts/identity and safe exit diagnostics; a real nonzero managed-process exit records childAlive=false and childExitCode=37 without publication.
qualifications.elapsed-time: Public workflows in both profiles separate wall-clock deadlines from monotonic elapsed limits, budgets and usage; forward/backward wall steps, frozen wall time with genuine elapsed excess, inclusive boundaries, ticker wraparound, real nanoTime and real long execution. Explicit Clock-only deterministic semantics remain qualified; initialization v2 rejects child relative-wall deadline conversion.
